prompts.tempest-oceanic: Create a production fantasy game UI sprite sheet for TEMPEST OCEANIC, using the supplied existing action-button atlas ONLY as a material/palette reference. These are NEW compact secondary controls, much simpler and cleaner than the large action frames. Six separate unlabeled button sprites on a flat pure white background, NO checkerboard, NO text, NO glyphs, NO stars in centres. Layout: exactly THREE horizontal rows evenly spaced (idle top, hover middle, pressed bottom). Each row has one wide rectangular button on the left (aspect ratio 4.5:1) and one square icon button on the right (1:1), SAME HEIGHT. Leave large white gaps, no touching. Outer silhouette and frame structure must be EXACTLY identical across states: modest clipped/beveled corners, straight horizontal rails, slim polished silver layered bevel, navy blue ocean-metal inset, tiny cyan corner accents. NO spikes or protruding gems. The large rectangle is for text labels; entire inner centre is empty very dark smooth navy charcoal, minimal texture, no focal symbol. Square centre also empty dark navy, for a native icon to be overlaid later. Hover: more intense cyan electricity confined to the narrow rim and corner accents, brighter silver bevel, keep entire central text area dark. Pressed: recessed dark bevel with interesting restrained turquoise wave energy in the INNER EDGE only, remain clearly darker than hover. Razor sharp beautiful high quality metal craftsmanship. Flat front view, no perspective. Make the rectangle and square both have unbroken straight edge centres suitable for nine-slice UI scaling. All six outer dimensions and registration within their shape must match across the three states. Canvas landscape 1536x1024.
